name: OpenLineage
description: Open standard for metadata and lineage collection. Instruments pipelines as they run in Spark Airflow dbt Flink and more. The de-facto open standard adopted by Marquez Datahub and Atlan.
best_for: Automated data lineage from Spark Airflow dbt, open standard integration
pricing_notes: Completely free and open-source; adopted by managed platforms
tags: lineage metadata open-standard pipelines tracing observability spark airflow dbt

name: Marquez
description: Open-source metadata service for the collection discovery and tracking of dataset pipeline and job metadata built on OpenLineage. Reference implementation of OpenLineage metadata storage.
best_for: OpenLineage metadata storage, job lineage tracking, dataset discovery for data teams
tags: marquez lineage metadata openlineage reference job-tracking dataset discovery

name: DataHub
description: Open-source metadata platform for data discovery lineage and governance. Originally built at LinkedIn and now one of the most popular open-source data catalog solutions with 9K+ GitHub stars.
best_for: Data discovery, end-to-end lineage, data cataloging, metadata management at scale
pricing_notes: Open-source free; Acryl Cloud managed from $25K/year
tags: datahub linkedin metadata catalog lineage governance discovery open-source

name: Collibra Data Lineage
description: Enterprise end-to-end data lineage solution providing automated technical lineage business lineage and column-level lineage. Integrates with 100+ sources including Informatica dbt Spark and SSIS.
best_for: Enterprise-grade column-level lineage, audit compliance, regulated industries
pricing_notes: Part of Collibra enterprise suite; from $100K/year
tags: collibra lineage enterprise column-level technical business audit compliance regulated

name: Alation Data Lineage
description: Lineage capability embedded within Alation's data intelligence platform. Provides automated end-to-end data lineage from source to consumption across BI tools ETL and ML workflows.
best_for: Lineage within data catalog workflow, BI impact analysis, governance
pricing_notes: Part of Alation platform; enterprise subscription
tags: alation lineage catalog governance bi impact analysis etl ml

name: Informatica IDMC
description: Enterprise data integration and governance cloud platform (IDMC). Provides intelligent data management with metadata lineage data quality data masking and AI-powered CLAIRE metadata engine.
best_for: Enterprise ETL lineage, legacy integration, data masking, regulated data governance
pricing_notes: Enterprise pricing from $100K+/year; IPO'd 2023 trading ~$17B market cap
tags: informatica idmc lineage enterprise data-integration governance masking claire

name: Apache Atlas
description: Open-source data governance and metadata framework for Hadoop and cloud data platforms. Provides classification lineage and metadata management with integration to HBase Hive Kafka and Ranger.
best_for: Hadoop ecosystem lineage, on-premise data governance, Hive/HBase catalog
tags: atlas apache hadoop lineage governance metadata classification hive

name: Spline (ABSA)
description: Open-source data lineage tracking solution for Apache Spark. Captures Spark execution plans and presents them as visual lineage graphs. Simple to integrate with minimal code changes to existing Spark jobs.
best_for: Spark data lineage, data engineering pipeline tracking, job impact analysis
enterprise_clients: Data engineering teams using Spark,ABSA Group
tags: spline spark lineage absa apache open-source pipeline tracking

name: Monte Carlo Data
description: End-to-end data observability platform with automated lineage incident detection anomaly alerts and root cause analysis. Pioneer of data observability with ML-driven monitoring of data pipelines.
best_for: Data quality incident detection, automated lineage, ML-driven pipeline monitoring
tags: monte-carlo data-observability lineage incident-detection anomaly ml-monitoring pipelines
